regions.name: 纳尔谢
questions: 真正新游戏候选已恢复；继续补空装备所有权、序章字段宿主及后续剧情演化。
建立同一地点在不同世界阶段、剧情标记和局部状态下的变体条件。
确认 Wait 时钟与 SysCall 选择器，并对已恢复的碰撞进行原版运行对照。

regions.name: 歌剧院
questions: 将区域地图、演出资源包、Timeline 根与实际事件触发对应。
选择一个短镜头并补齐外部模型、动画、材质与音频引用。
确认时间线时钟、后处理、结束与跳过的状态回写。

facts.subject: narshe
facts.value: Abilities 218/219/220/222 select condition group 402, whose row 104 refers to condition row 13 (type 601, Kappa). IsSelectableCommand at RVA 0x76a800 compares actor condition row IDs against both ability and command groups. Command 26 selects group 302, also row 13. Silence row 6 does not intersect these Magitek restrictions. This is actor eligibility, not an alive-target predicate; complete Kappa behavior is not implemented.

facts.subject: narshe
facts.value: Ability 222 selects function group 431: Recovery(2,2,0) followed by Unique(0,0,0), with process_prog None. Unique is not a status-removal function. The native FF6 provider selects calculated HP recovery; status/target overrides and full runtime parity are separate dependencies.

facts.subject: narshe
facts.value: Development v5 uses shared neutral magic arithmetic for the existing beams and calculated recovery. Source flag identities, hit/variance draw order, enemy factor, defense and caps are checked. 83 source records have controlled scalar probes, not full spell support. Browser recovery, beams, victory and field return passed; statuses, affinities, accessories, full AI and original parity remain incomplete.

facts.subject: narshe
facts.value: Development v6 replaces the provisional enemy physical formula and supports player selected-arm parameters, strength, physical variance-before-hit, integer multiply and ordinary critical draws. Source abilities 1/399 pass controlled BattleGame actions; 181 candidates have isolated scalar checks. Browser enemy attacks, evasion, recovery, beams, victory and field return passed. No new story command, region, AI, numerical status, equipment effect or original-parity claim.

facts.subject: narshe
facts.value: Development v7 shares typed single/side/all requests, impact-time target selection, per-target effects, one action cost and rollback of numerical state and RNG on a later target failure. Source ability 345 passes controlled one/two-target actions and browser UI with independent 41/46 damage. Position groups, death/revival eligibility, reflection, confusion, full AI and original parity remain incomplete. No new story command or region is unlocked.

facts.subject: narshe
facts.value: Development v8 uses explicit elemental inputs, physical priority and ordered magic calculations, separate immune results and signed absorption. Monster 26 fire weakness is projected into the existing opening catalog. Source fire beam 218 passes controlled browser immunity and absorption with HP 2000 to 2181. Unknown carriers 743/754/757 and conflicting resistance groups 81/125 remain blocked. Full statuses, dynamic affinities, equipment lifecycle, AI, saves and original parity remain incomplete.

facts.subject: narshe
facts.value: Development v9 shares HP-zero death identity, dying threshold, player revival, cancellation of charged actions and post-battle status persistence. Source abilities 34/35 pass 16 controlled boundary and frame-partition checks. Browser Raise restores player:31 from 0/80 to 10/80 HP, clears death, retains dying and resets ATB. Enemy revival AI/rewards, undead, automatic revival, full scheduling and original parity remain incomplete. No new story unlock or region.

facts.subject: narshe
facts.value: Development v10 replaces Guard/Silver Lobo templates with source-addressed normal AI control flow, conditional jumps, action-table cycles and per-enemy state. Normal decisions share the action queue and roll back AI state and RNG on target failure. 430 source scripts have diagnostics; 156 fully decoded normal programs are not playable-enemy coverage. Three additional source AI scripts pass controlled-host replay; existing five encounters and browser opening victory/field return pass. Ability 696, counters, interrupts, variables, full targeting/scheduling and original parity remain incomplete. No new story region.

facts.subject: narshe
facts.value: Development v11 adds independently owned 15-cell enemy variables, separate mode, current HP/MP branches and transactional AI initialization/turn decisions. 430 source scripts are diagnosed; 165 fully decoded normal programs are not playable-enemy coverage. Five source AI programs pass controlled-host replay; constructed Soul Saver and Lesser Lopros checkpoints test variable/MP control flow without executing missing abilities. 239 TypeScript and 18 Python tests, existing five encounters, field arithmetic regression and browser opening victory/return pass. LoopAct, reactions/interrupts, ability/event parameter writers, complete scheduling and original parity remain incomplete. No new story region.

facts.subject: narshe
facts.value: Development v12 adds source LoopAct repeats as one action-table turn, atomic group admission, per-action cost/target rechecks and gauge release after the last pending normal action. All 97 source LoopAct instructions pass isolated decoding/selection checks; two original instructions run in explicitly synthetic normal tables and replay across frame partitions. Their full enemy programs remain blocked on unimplemented triggers. 249 TypeScript and 18 Python tests and the existing five encounters pass. Browser controlled actions 462,1,1 retain ATB 100 after the first two actions and release it after the third. Browser opening victory, field return and movement also pass. Counter/final triggers, complete scheduling, dynamic abilities, global party/inventory/save and original parity remain incomplete. No new region or story unlock.

facts.subject: narshe
facts.value: Development v13 adds primary-result reaction classification, source CounterAct, priority FIFO and atomic effect/AI/reaction commits. Counters preserve pending normal actions and gauges; self actions and counter chains do not trigger ordinary counters. All 233 source CounterAct instructions pass isolated decoding/selection checks, with two original instructions in explicitly synthetic hosts; full Templar and Tonberry programs remain blocked. 207 fully decoded AI programs are not playable-enemy coverage. 262 TypeScript and 18 Python tests, existing five encounters and browser opening victory/field return pass. Browser controlled actions 1,379,1 preserve enemy ATB 100 through its counter and release it after its normal action. Counter count one adopts a native constructor default in the bounded host; effective original deserialization is unverified. Final/recovery-special triggers, complete scheduling, dynamic abilities, global party/inventory/save and original parity remain incomplete. No new region or story unlock.

facts.subject: narshe
facts.value: Development shared state v1 centralizes opening roster progress, party, six equipment slot identities, ordinary/important item stacks, Gil and occurrence-based victory receipts. Battles borrow isolated entry state and retry from it; complete growth and field-return validation precede reward publication. 271 TypeScript and 18 Python tests, 50 source item identity/quantity checks, existing five encounters and browser opening menus pass. Browser post-battle levels are 3/2/2, HP 63/63/70, Gil 3096 and the initial key item remains one. Fifty stack identities are not fifty usable items. Snapshot roundtrip is an owned-state fragment, not a complete save game; full roster initialization, item use, equipment changes, learning, field inventory events, browser persistence and original parity remain incomplete. No new region or story unlock. This is the shared-state milestone record; later session persistence is tracked by migration.checkpointSaves.

facts.subject: narshe
facts.value: Development checkpoint v1 joins owned state, plot variables, map identity, entity groups, actors, doors, animation/audio progress and encounter sequence. Idle map saves persist to browser storage with the previous slot retained; restore rebuilds trusted dependencies without rerunning map initialization or rewards. 277 TypeScript and 18 Python tests pass. Forty saves/restores through the existing five encounters produce the same final checkpoint as uninterrupted play; 131 already-idle entrances across 63 map records pass source-backed restore and frame-partition checks, not playable-map acceptance. Browser refresh/continue, movement, cleared guard trigger, current/previous slots and repeated paused loading pass after separating audio preparation from playback. Active event/battle saves, full initialization, items/equipment/learning, native save permission/format, version migration and original parity remain incomplete. No new region or story unlock.

facts.subject: narshe
facts.value: Development v14 connects ordinary fixed HP/MP recovery items across the menu, battle, shared inventory and idle checkpoints. Content IDs remain distinct from item and ability row IDs; menu/battle function groups compile independently. Eight menu and nine battle item plans are admitted, limited to living players. Fifty identities in two contexts are decoded, not fifty usable items. Shared effect projections, stock reservations, one consumption per action, entry-state retry and atomic victory receipts are implemented. 286 TypeScript and 18 Python tests, 17 source-backed controlled item probes, the existing five encounters and 40 checkpoint restores pass. Browser controlled menu recovery, last-item reservation, party recovery, victory return and in-memory checkpoint restore pass; the normal opening browser battle/field/menu also passes, retaining the sole initial key item. No test items were granted to the normal game, and the old version save was rejected but preserved. Revive/condition cure and special items, enemy item reactions, equipment changes, event inventory writes, full initialization and native timing/random parity remain incomplete. No new region, story unlock or HD-2D work.

facts.subject: narshe
facts.value: Development v15 integrates ordinary equipment changes, field item/Gil events, revival and supported condition-cure items through one owned state. Equipment quantities include worn copies; availability accounts for the entire roster. Slot/job qualification, atomic hand conflict handling, real-copy transfer, raw growth reprojection and snapshot v2 validation are implemented. 223 source equipment identities yield 106 admitted including five empty placeholders and 117 explicit blockers; 423 isolated eligibility previews and 18 existing slots are checked, not full-world acquisition. Of 173 field GetItem/RemoveItem/RemoveGil sites, 117 ordinary/important-item and Gil sites are admitted with 411 controlled probes; equipment/magicstone events and quantity queries remain incomplete. Map preparation keeps inventory changes private until publication and rejects stale state. Menu/battle contain 14/16 item plans but active conditions remain only 4/5/6/100; 17 fixed-recovery and 29 revive/cure source probes pass. 323 TypeScript and 18 Python tests, existing five encounters and 40 checkpoint restores pass. Final-catalog browser checks cover real equipment transfer, preview/battle agreement, growth and in-memory restore; item revival/cure uses explicitly controlled inputs. Normal opening menu equip/unequip, natural battle victory, map return and movement pass; at (38,35), Gil is 3096, levels 3/2/2 and HP 63/63/64 with initial key item unchanged. No extra formal equipment or consumables were granted and previous user saves were preserved. Full initialization/roster/party, acquisition/drop/steal, learning, other statuses/passives/special equipment, scheduling and original parity remain incomplete. No new region, story unlock or HD-2D work.

facts.subject: narshe
facts.value: Development v16 integrates three banks of four party positions, equipment acquisition/vitality and received-ability AI conditions through a single owned-state transaction. Active membership derives from the selected bank; map candidates publish inventory and party together. Snapshot v3 retains empty cells/rows; empty and back-row battles remain blocked. Of 196 source party instructions, 45 execute in the field and 151 actor-refresh paths remain blocked; 392 pure probes and 70 controlled presentation callbacks do not establish real actor refresh. Join/departure/disabled ownership remain unimplemented. Inventory admits 134 of 173 source sites with 462 probes, including 17 equipment grants and controlled save/battle chains; equipment admits 119 of 223 identities including five empty placeholders, with 104 blockers and 459 eligibility previews. Eleven parameters now include source-bound two-stage vitality. AI received-ability identity/system branches cover 26 instructions and two controlled host executions of the unchanged Templar program; original status 903 and abilities 3/40 still block the full enemy. 367 TypeScript and 18 Python tests, existing five encounters, 40 stable checkpoint restores and source-system regressions pass. Browser controlled crown equipment changes vitality 28 to 31 across preview, in-memory restore and battle; normal opening victory returns to (38,37) with 3096 Gil, levels 3/2/2, HP 63/63/43 and the initial key item unchanged. Final battle-menu participant cleanup passes six controlled DOM cases and browser selection. No extra formal stock, user-save overwrite, region expansion or HD-2D work. Static native receipts remain semanticsVerified=false; system and full-game gates remain incomplete.

facts.subject: narshe
facts.value: Development v17 integrates roster lifecycle metadata/enabled equipment ownership, source battle clock gates/chanting, and ordinary poison through shared state. Snapshot v4 keeps native owned identity, jobs/additional level and global released jobs; inventory, party and roster share one candidate revision. Six exact lifecycle selectors decode 19 source sites; 103 remain blocked. All 19 real field paths still block on actor refresh; 10 controlled callbacks publish and 9 require missing new-owner providers. Source timing checks cover 1530 abilities and 9180 inputs; action presentation no longer freezes allowed progress, interrupt counters bypass chanting, and end judgment follows same-frame condition updates. Ordinary poison admits 17 of 25 source actions, with 20 controlled source/menu/battle checks; source row 88 and field walking damage remain blocked. Failed simulation steps roll back owned combat values, queues, RNG, AI, clocks, inventory and time; invalid dead-plus-poison stable saves are rejected. 430 TypeScript and 18 Python tests, five existing encounters and 40 stable restores pass. Browser controlled poison changes HP 63 to 60 then uses a 16-second period; victory and in-memory restore retain poison, one antidote cures and releases the field movement guard. Normal opening victory returns to (38,37), 3096 Gil, levels 3/2/2 and HP 63/63/58. No user save overwrite, region expansion or HD-2D work. Full actor presentation, owner initialization/growth/learning, other statuses and special battle reactions remain incomplete; static native receipts are semanticsVerified=false and all systems/full-game gates remain incomplete.

facts.subject: narshe
facts.value: Development v18 integrates source ordinary owned initialization, field poison step transactions and WAIT menus/preferences. Opening owners keep 63/4/4 owned abilities, 63 global history IDs including unlearned entries, and only the TINA name tag. 18 source initializations compile and 16 remain blocked; actual story owner creation, growth/learning and actor refresh remain incomplete. Owned state v5 and session/field/world checkpoints v2 preserve abilities/history/names, WAIT preference and independent transportation identity. Move-start snapshots commit once before destination events and battle borrowing; stale or forged transport/state fails atomically. Opening transport is unknown and poisoned movement stays blocked; explicit transport 1 is a controlled probe. Browser HP 63->62->61 restores to 62 and WAIT; 8.1 seconds in WAIT keeps 62, active mode gives 59, one antidote plus controlled victory/return and a field step keeps 59. A workbench victory clock-readout error was fixed and the exit path replayed without console errors. 467 TypeScript and 18 Python tests, source regressions, five encounters, 40 restores and 131 existing idle entrances pass. Normal opening move/pause/WAIT/save availability pass without overwriting user saves. No new playable regions or HD-2D; native receipts remain semanticsVerified=false, full systems and full-game gates incomplete.

facts.subject: narshe
facts.value: UpdateNameTag selects character_default_name by character_id and uses tag_name as MessageManager key; mes_id_name only localizes the display name. Source character 1 binds TINA, while 31 and 32 have no matching default-name row and return without binding. This static source observation does not establish dynamic rename dialogue rendering.

facts.subject: narshe
facts.value: Field MoveEndAction runs condition damage only for current transport type 1. RideVehicleNPC changes rider presentation without proving currentTransport identity; the Magitek mount and operand 6 must not infer transport 6 or poison immunity. Source ordinary condition row 10 uses maxHP/32 integer damage, keeps living HP at least 1, and executes before destination events. The opening development checkpoint is now independently bound to transport 6/type 12 by the actual 609 -> 572 -> 3 prelude, so it skips ordinary poison steps. The earlier unresolved selection has been closed by additional source evidence, not by the mount image.

facts.subject: narshe
facts.value: Development v19 integrates 18 ordinary source owner/growth templates, source CorrectLevel additional experience, natural level learning, candidate-owned party appearance and checkpoint actor identities. Actual initial owners remain 1/31/32; controlled owner 2 joins at level5/EXP400/HP48-max102 without auto-healing and cannot battle without its definition. Source prelude 609/572/3 binds transport6/type12 and nested actor outer38/riders1,31,31. FullRecovery implies setDummy=false refresh; only explicit current-script KeepBadStatusVisual=0 bypasses another native entity handoff. Missing media and invalid checkpoints fail atomically. Owned v6, field/world v3 and session v2 preserve these boundaries. 526 TS and18 Python tests,30 source groups/39 commands,11 controlled integration scenarios,5 existing encounters/40 restores pass. 131 world entrances are a separate geometry-only mechanism with native-party host explicitly omitted; formal actor map initialization remains blocked. Browser latest opening move/pause/equipment/save availability pass without writing user saves. No story expansion, HD2D or full migration acceptance; static native evidence is not dynamic parity.

Command26 requires condition row53/type607; mount artwork and field transportation6 do not prove that battle condition. facts.value: Treasure CheckItemCountOver reads ordinary owned records including worn copies, not free equipment or the important list. Capacity affects messaging, not reward admission. Explicit TreasureBox after=true/message=false bypasses the opened-flag check and uses actionSoundId0. All22 silent instructions in this source have zero reward quantities; admitting them is not22 complete collectible treasure interactions. isOpen and the treasure flag must remain distinct across checkpoints.

facts.value: The non-advertisement prelude sc_e_0001[18] AddCondition(607,0) resolves type607 to row53 and appends it to the selected Corps owners, not the entire roster or a transportation-derived battle temporary. Six pinned scripts bind the opening checkpoint. Formal development-static admission remains until owned field transactions and Magitek presentation are integrated.

facts.subject: narshe
facts.value: Ordinary treasure interaction and explicit message tasks share owned inventory, fresh capacity reads and source message bindings. Reward commits before messages; the treasure flag commits after confirmation and the final message frame. Retained windows, independent script handoff, anonymous entities and concurrent handoff guards are implemented. Source-world compilation retains unsupported map and message-control gates; sound remains an explicit muted development omission.

facts.subject: narshe
facts.value: Eighteen exact ordinary player definitions are potential templates, not initial ownership or learned actions. Current owned growth, equipment, HP and learned state override template defaults. GameSession and BattleGame enforce source qualification, known conditions and ordinary appearance before admission. Formal opening remains development-static, so these templates alone do not unlock normal characters in story battles.

facts.subject: narshe
facts.value: In v22, source type607 resolves to row53 in owned state. Field add/remove prepares all ordered actor refreshes before commit; target0 is current Corps, -1 is enabled roster, positive targets are source character identities. Explicit development-checkpoint seeds are not replayed after restore. Source qualification replaces the static opening menu, while unknown actual field-entry dependencies still block. Full prelude execution and native dynamic parity remain incomplete.

facts.subject: narshe
facts.value: Source Magitek Start/Remove saves and restores a posture category, not a pixel height. Body and armor follow independent source aliases, UV offsets and local positions; exact R aliases supply right-facing media. Full-rect geometry uses PPU1, bottom-center pivot, point sampling and Clamp edges. v22 admits this lifecycle with strict media checks; full animation scheduling, transformed states and original-game visual parity remain unverified.

facts.subject: narshe
facts.value: The source contains 1530 ability definitions. v23 compiles their dependency closure independently of ownership, with 260 bounded host plans and explicit blockers for the rest. Character 1 naturally knows abilities 31 and 40; catalogue membership does not grant a skill. Special MP providers, reflection, Runic and unsupported active states remain gated.

facts.subject: narshe
facts.value: Command 2 refers to ability 2, function type15 and condition row1/type1/until1. The source halves qualifying physical damage after defense, clears Defend on admitted ordinary ATB actions but not direct counter actions, and uses Ready posture for living defenders. v23 admits the bounded lifecycle; special action and presentation branches remain unverified.

facts.subject: narshe
facts.value: Source field battle exclusions read actual transportation, foot-event save-point membership and the BeastField controller cache. v23 can prove no save point only from all active source groups, and ordinary ground only after explicit map-entry completion. Bootstrap without synchronization evidence stays unknown; attribute grids and real save-point callbacks remain unresolved.

facts.subject: narshe
facts.value: Ordinary condition rows 23/type19 and 22/type412 reduce physical and magic damage at different integer calculation stages. They persist through ordinary ATB actions, clear on death and battle end, and do not enter owned field status. v24 admits seven bounded ability definitions; alternate rows 93/94 and source particles remain unsupported.

facts.subject: narshe
facts.value: Equipment content 304/305 adds one skill-zero owned passive record per equipped copy through wear function62. Fees use float32 half rounded AwayFromZero or positive cost one, with 305 precedence. v24 preserves passive copy order through changes, natural growth and saved owned state. Enemy level-zero actions remain eligible below their fee and clamp paid MP to zero; other equipment effects and cost providers remain blocked.

facts.subject: narshe
facts.value: Enemy death registers monster identity in death order without source-ID deduplication. Victory rolls drop_rate then one of eight weighted slots, merges rewards in first-result order, and admits items or equipment through owned inventory after used-item removal. v24 source compilation admits 499 of 508 ordinary drop definitions; nine missing content references remain blocked. These are provider counts, not playable monsters. Web result confirmation timing and RNG sequence have not passed original-game parity.

facts.subject: narshe
facts.value: Player row is projected from the current party cell, while equipment exceptions use six owned entry slots. Actor and target penalties occupy distinct source integer stages. Non-player parameters use Front. Missing ownership blocks physical action; ranged equipment, dual wield, Change command and special formations are not granted by row metadata.

facts.subject: narshe
facts.value: Ordinary condition rows 21/type15 and 25/type16 use separate ATB, chanting and progress-cycle providers. Slow accumulates float32 delta time without an ordinary until2 expiry. Clocks are battle-local and transactional; special row95 remains blocked. Twenty-four source action plans admit the shared behavior without granting learned actions.

facts.subject: narshe
facts.value: Ordinary action8 ShopNPC shares NPC interaction and source greeting/close messages. A single owned transaction publishes stock and Gil after full-count, equipped-copy and money-headroom checks. The catalog admits 92 groups and 595 products; 64 of 71 source entities satisfy current dependencies, not story reachability. Special script shops remain blocked.

facts.subject: narshe
facts.value: Source config indices 0..4 map to ATB speeds 0.5,0.75,1,1.5,2; default index2. The source applies speed before battle startup. Web session v3 persists the mode and index, while live changes preserve cached charge and poison thresholds. Static source and Web probes are separate from original runtime timing parity.

facts.subject: narshe
facts.value: Ordinary row9 persists across battles, is erased by the actual death conflict rules and is removable by admitted items. Blind halves physical attacker accuracy after the upper cap; target plus/minus type arrays also affect physical and magic accuracy with distinct RNG order. Special row89 and native effect presentation remain blocked. Twelve bounded ability plans are definitions, not acquired skills.

facts.subject: narshe
facts.value: The source-bound extra-ability weapon list contains 19 records and is mandatory independently of weapon.csv. Ordinary ranged metadata admits ten additional descriptors, seven with jobs and three without equip rights. Native special weapon11/30 remain blocked despite process=None. The six-slot battle lease is cross-checked with row metadata; no story acquisition is implied.

facts.subject: narshe
facts.value: Fresh source initialization clears event banks and builds initial owners, inventory and transportation before map609/entrance1/script1. It does not start with the Narshe checkpoint Magitek state or transport6. Empty equipment quantities are retained separately in the candidate. Publication remains blocked until their ownership lifecycle and the source field host are implemented.
